{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp only mechanically to adapt to CScriptWitness accessor methods without altering kernel APIs or boundaries.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel files are only touched for mechanical call-site updates."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/policy/policy.cpp and mempool tests are mechanical updates from direct stack access to witness accessor methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change mempool policy or validation rules, only updating call sites to the new witness API."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp purely as a caller update for CScriptWitness accessors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Block template construction logic and mining interfaces are unchanged."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Alters net_processing.cpp and P2P deserialization to drop empty-input/output transactions and messages exceeding 4M weight before allocating memory.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Mitigates peer-induced memory exhaustion and deserialization DoS during P2P message processing. Transactions exceeding block limits or with empty inputs/outputs are dropped at the deserialization stage rather than processed into validation or reject filters."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp are mechanical migrations to the new span-based witness accessor methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC interfaces and returned data remain unchanged; modifications are purely internal caller updates."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds benchmarks and fuzz harnesses specific to script witness deserialization rather than changing test runner or harness infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test and benchmark additions directly support the CScriptWitness rewrite rather than modifying general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/bitcoin-tx.cpp are mechanical updates conforming to the new CScriptWitness API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Command-line tool functionality is not modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to serialize.h and streams.h specifically support CScriptWitness serialization rather than general utility library features.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to serialization headers are subsidiary to the transaction and witness primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes CScriptWitness storage and transaction/block deserialization bounds in src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/script.h, and src/script/interpreter.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.73,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Eliminates an adversarial memory exhaustion vector where worst-case valid 4 MB blocks consumed over 100 MiB of memory during deserialization. Benchmarks show deserialization time for a valid block filled with empty witness elements drops from 279.2 ms to 18.7 ms, with peak memory dropping from 182.2 MiB to 7.8 MiB."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates in wallet files and PSBT logic are mechanical conversions to span-based witness accessors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Wallet state, coin selection, and transaction signing are functionally unchanged."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 2,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
